text: Richard Mille is a Swiss luxury watchmaker founded in 2001, based in Les Breuleux, Switzerland; its Ferrari partner page describes it as a pre-eminent player in watchmaking.
short: Richard Mille is a Swiss luxury watchmaker founded in 2001.

source.name: Ferrari – Richard Mille Team Partner page
source.quote: Founded in 2001, RICHARD MILLE quickly established itself as one of the pre-eminent players within the watchmaking industry

additionalSources.name: Wikipedia – Richard Mille
additionalSources.quote: Richard Mille is a Swiss luxury watchmaker founded in 2001 [ 1 ] by Dominique Guenat and Richard Mille, based in Les Breuleux , Switzerland.
